title: RefinementGuard: Counterexample-Directed Semantic Qualification for Hidden Agent-Tool Execution
title_zh: RefinementGuard：面向隐藏式智能体工具执行的反例引导语义验证
abstract_en: Tool runtimes can lower an agent-selected operation into a hidden parallel graph, reducing latency and context while risking semantic mistranslation. We introduce RefinementGuard: translation validation for hidden, effectful agent-tool lowerings, coupled to artifact-bound, fail-closed runtime admission. Qualification compares a candidate graph with an independent reference on isolated state using explicit parent-operation obligations. We evaluate two repository-level contracts, bug localization and patch validation, on controlled repositories. Among 100 activated, non-equivalent development/qualification faults adjudicated by one human, parent-semantic validation rejects 49/100 (operator-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]). The objective is selective admission, not maximum mutation rejection: exact equality rejects 100/100 faults but also all 60 valid variants, whereas obligation-based validation accepts 60/60; its 51 residual misses identify concrete specification gaps. On a frozen disjoint input split, the held-out B2-B3 result is localization-only because 21 patch mutants fail structurally; B3 rejects 38/56 localization defects. In a controlled asynchronous-delay regime, the localization serial/guarded median-latency ratio is 4.50x, and hidden execution exposes 74.3% less parent-visible context than visible execution. Patch validation shows no demonstrated speedup; zero-delay runs expose overhead. End-to-end qualification thus detects lower-layer misses while preserving localization's parallelism.
abstract_zh: 工具运行时可将智能体选定的操作转换为隐藏的并行执行图，以降低延迟和上下文开销，但转换可能改变原操作的语义。RefinementGuard 在隔离状态下，依据上层操作的显式语义约束，对照独立参考实现验证候选执行图。验证结果与执行产物绑定，未通过验证的产物默认不予执行。研究在受控代码仓库中评估了缺陷定位和补丁验证两类任务。经一名人工评审员判定，在 100 个被触发且与参考行为不等价的故障中，语义验证拒绝了 49 个（按算子聚类的 Bootstrap 95% 置信区间为 33.7%–64.8%），同时放行了全部 60 个合法变体；严格等价检查虽然拒绝了全部故障，却也误拒了全部合法变体。未检出的 51 个故障揭示了具体的规范缺口。在预先冻结的独立测试划分中，21 个补丁变异体未通过结构检查，因此 B2–B3 的留出集结果仅适用于缺陷定位，其中 B3 拒绝了 56 个缺陷中的 38 个。在受控异步延迟条件下，串行缺陷定位的中位延迟是受验证保护的并行执行的 4.50 倍，隐藏执行向上层暴露的上下文比可见执行少 74.3%。补丁验证未显示加速，零延迟实验则表明验证本身会引入开销。
key_points_zh: 在隔离状态下将候选执行图与独立参考实现对照，按上层操作的语义约束判定是否放行，并将验证结果绑定到具体执行产物。
语义验证拒绝 49/100 个故障、放行 60/60 个合法变体；严格等价检查拒绝全部故障，也误拒全部合法变体。剩余 51 个漏检指出了规范缺口。
独立留出集上的 B2–B3 结果仅适用于缺陷定位：B3 拒绝 38/56 个缺陷；21 个补丁变异体未通过结构检查。
在受控异步延迟下，串行缺陷定位的中位延迟是受验证保护的并行执行的 4.50 倍，隐藏执行向上层暴露的上下文减少 74.3%。补丁验证未显示加速，零延迟时可观察到验证开销。

llm_assessment.comment: Operation-level contracts validate parallel tool execution without requiring exact equivalence, but substantial defect misses and narrow speedup evidence limit confidence.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 操作级契约无需要求完全等价即可验证工具的并行执行，但仍有大量缺陷未检出，且加速证据仅限于少数场景。
